enabled.description: Enable or disable the Pacemaker SNMP agent.

listen_address.description: IP address or hostname the SNMP agent will bind to.

listen_port.description: UDP port on which the SNMP agent listens for requests. Standard port for pcs-snmp is 1911.

items.description: SNMPv1/v2c community string (read-only). Multiple entries allowed.

communities.description: List of read-only SNMP community strings. Add multiple entries for multi-tenant or segmented monitoring.

auth_protocol.description: Authentication protocol (SHA or MD5). SHA is recommended.

priv_protocol.description: Privacy (encryption) protocol (AES or DES). AES is recommended.

snmpv3_users.description: List of SNMPv3 users with authentication and privacy settings. Required for secure monitoring.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs (0=quiet, 5=debug). Higher values increase log size.

cib_path.description: Path to the Pacemaker CIB XML cache file. Usually auto-managed by pcs-snmp.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent SNMP connections. Adjust for high-load monitoring environments.

send_traps.description: Enable or disable sending of SNMP traps for cluster events (e.g., resource failover, node down).

host.description: Hostname or IP of trap receiver.

trap_destinations.description: List of SNMP trap destinations. Traps are sent for cluster health events if enabled.

mib_prefixes.description: Optional custom MIB prefix mappings for non-default MIB resolution.
